Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Anthropic completes an IPO — defined as its shares beginning to trade on a public stock exchange following an effective registration statement — strictly after 2026-09-30T21:31:29.137Z and at or before 2026-11-30T00:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if no such IPO trading commencement occurs within the window described above.

Clarifications:
